training_source: EmoBox academic data is used for seed fine-tuning, followed by teacher pseudo-labelling and data iteration to large; this project counts those corpora as used through upstream training. Large also uses 42,526 h of industrial pseudo-labelled audio. This is distinct from a claim that every EmoBox corpus directly entered large encoder self-supervised pretraining
notes: One prediction per clip (FunASR, granularity utterance); FunASR averages stereo channels and resamples the audio to 16 kHz.

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actor was asked to portray, from the first part of the file name (`dis`gusto, `gio`ia, `neu`trale, `pau`ra, `rab`bia, `sor`presa, `tri`stezza)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 9 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 9 classes (they add up to 1)

training_reason: Author documents EmoBox seed training and iterative pseudo-label lineage into large; the exact seed corpus subset and raw-audio/weight inheritance into large are not enumerated.
